faq.q: What amenities does Pacific Terrace have?
faq.a: Concierge, an indoor pool, hot tub and sauna, exercise equipment, a library, workshop, guest suite and a rooftop lounge and sundeck.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings of any listing in the building. Call or text 604-928-1361 or email jaredgibbons@royallepage.ca.

Russell Avenue is in the Town Centre, near Miramar Village. The strata record lists no pets; check the current bylaws before you buy if you have one.
Before you buy at Pacific Terrace

items.t: the Form B, two years of minutes, the bylaws, the depreciation report and the contingency reserve fund balance. They show what Pacific Terrace owners are planning to fix and pay for.
since November 24, 2022, BC stratas cannot ban owners from renting, except in age-restricted buildings. Short-term rental limits can still apply.
pet limits, parking stalls, storage lockers and electric car charging are set by the bylaws and the title, home by home. Check them for the exact home you are buying.
